author: Ariadne I
title: Osc2-CTX-FLoad (k=320, p=48) + V-OrthoReg: Factorized Loadings + Oscillatory SSM
abstract: Scale to k=320 with factorized loadings (p=48) and add a mild orthogonality regularizer on V columns (V^T V≈I) to reduce redundancy in the projection basis. Uses oscillatory 2nd-order SSM factors, input-adaptive temporal gating, global horizon gating, residual copy head, and MAE+curvature loss.
